issue.title: Coordinate bob ref rename/move, id stamp, and create --force PDF writes with open Highlights documents

task_type_fields.proposal:
Route the remaining Highlights-PDF writers through the same bounded `.forMerging`
coordination that `bob ref scan` / `ref sync -w` / create-time ingest now use, so an
open Highlights document is saved first and reloaded in place for every bob PDF write:

- `bob ref rename` / move: `rename/plan.rs` `write_id_marker` currently runs
  `execute_pdf_sync` with `MarkerWriteSession::uncoordinated()`, and the rename moves
  the PDF file itself (a move likely needs `NSFileCoordinatorWritingOptions::ForMoving`
  plus `itemAtURL:didMoveToURL:` rather than the existing merging-write primitive).
- the id stamp (`stamp.rs` → `atomic_save_pdf`).
- `bob ref create --force` overwriting an existing target (`pdf_target.rs`
  → `atomic_save_pdf`).

Once those coordinate, the Bob Refs rename card can drop its "Close the PDF in
Highlights first." hint (bob-mac-capture `RefsRenamePresentation.quietHint` in
`Sources/RefsCore/RefsRename.swift`).

Primitive: `src/native/file_coordination.rs` (`coordinate_merging_write`); executor and
hold vocabulary: `src/native/highlights_ref/marker_write.rs`. Design reference:
decisions:open-pdf-writes-are-coordinated.

Proposed by bob-cli-at.7 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #2); filed by the bob-cli-at land agent.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope:
The bob-cli-at epic scoped coordination to marker writes from scan, sync, and ingest and
listed "Coordinating rename, stamp, or create --force" under Out of scope; moves need a
different coordination option and their own hold/rollback semantics.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-at coordinated only scan/sync/ingest marker writes; the other atomic_save_pdf writers can still strand an open Highlights document, and the rename card still tells Bryan to close the PDF first.

payload.description: Follow-up proposed by bob-cli-at.7; builds on the coordinated marker-write executor, hold vocabulary, and decisions:open-pdf-writes-are-coordinated
Both change how bob writes Highlights PDFs that may be open; a status-free marker would shrink the writes bob-cli-az must coordinate
Both can change the reference rename transaction; preserve PDF coordination and rollback semantics
Rank batch-9 successor candidates: content-loss and identity-repair scope
The break hides macOS CI results for az's Mac commit 9db33a6 (rename hint removal, retryable rename feedback test)
az coordinated rename/move, the id stamp, and create --force publication; this archive move stayed on merging-only access
az implemented the coordination the record does not yet describe

payload.entry: Fixed by batch-15 phase bob-cli-an.6.6.6.5.6.5.5.6.6.6.6.6.6.6.2 through child epic .2.1: bob-cli f00ae66e (bounded save-and-move coordination: coordinate_moving_write uses ForMerging|ForMoving with will/didMoveToURL and an inverse move_back); 1e923594 (rename/move plus id repair as one coordinated transaction: execute_rename_with_session -> rename_move_accessor/rename_merge_accessor -> write_id_marker_with_saved); 22882a7d and 0971ad56 (guarded publish boundary, highlights_ref/publish.rs, for create --force and the other public stamped-PDF writers); 0e6b0400 (acceptance kit covers rename and stamp); da3fa751 (dead uncoordinated rename path deleted; MarkerWriteSession::uncoordinated is test-only). bob-mac-capture 9db33a6 removed the Bob Refs rename card's close-the-PDF hint. LANDER FIX: f00ae66e's macOS-only tests never compiled, so bob-cli macOS CI failed its lint on every commit from f00ae66e to da3fa751 and the move tests never ran. 0a5f0793 fixes the three compile errors (checked locally with an aarch64-apple-darwin clippy gate). CI run 40462474420 is green on ubuntu and macOS, and all nine file_coordination::macos_tests ran natively, including the NSDocument presenter fixtures moving_scope_keeps_presenter_at_new_url_for_later_saves, inverse_move_notification_restores_presenter_url_for_rollback, and nsdocument_saves_reloads_and_holds_a_blocked_presenter. LIMITATIONS: real-Highlights acceptance is unrun (Mac offline; ssh mac timed out 2026-10-27), and highlights.coordinate_pdf_writes stays off until it passes (bob-cli-ay). 9db33a6 is not yet CI-verified because bob-mac-capture master has failed to build since unrelated 906a7df, filed as bob-cli-cz. Follow-ups filed: bob-cli-d0 (annotated-overwrite archive move without move notifications) and bob-cli-d1 (decision record scope).
